documents.text:
Raquel A Villamizar

Raquel A Villamizar is a researcher with the ORCID identifier 0000-0001-5225-0579. Career

Raquel A Villamizar has worked at the University of Pamplona. Evidence

According to her ORCID profile, Raquel A Villamizar has listed the University of Pamplona as one of her affiliations. [1] This suggests that she has worked or is currently working at the university. Additionally, a search on the University of Pamplona's website reveals that Raquel A Villamizar has been involved in research projects and has published papers in collaboration with other researchers from the university. [2]

Furthermore, her ResearchGate profile, a social networking site for scientists and researchers, also lists the University of Pamplona as one of her affiliations, providing further evidence of her association with the university. [3]
